annotations.text:
Decided: direction A, Instrument — now shipped in templates/viewer.html.

Two amendments folded in:
• the health score is C's graded scale — F D C B A marked on the bar, the band you are in lit, a marker at the score
• the file list is the old directory tree (folders, nesting, drill-through), restyled rather than replaced

Left artboard is what shipped before; right is what ships now. Same data in both.

What actually changed in the code: the token block and the stylesheet, four render functions (health, colour modes, census, tree) and the markup that carried emoji. Every id, class and handler the JS binds to is untouched — all seven views, four colour modes, both maps, the tree filter, tabs, search, blast/folders/tests toggles and PNG export were exercised after the change with no console errors.

No new network dependency: the mono stack is the system one (ui-monospace / SF Mono / Menlo / Consolas), not a webfont, because the explorer is meant to open from file:// with only force-graph coming off a CDN.
